result: 所有時間戳記（訂單、付款、退款、出貨、送達）都是 | 解讀: 文件主張時區規則；資料本身無時區標記，只能由換月影響量化其重要性。

query: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_ts) utc_m, strftime('%Y-%m', datetime(order_ts,'+8 hours')) tpe_m, COUNT(*) n FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', order_ts) <> strftime('%Y-%m', datetime(order_ts,'+8 hours')) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1
validation_method: 比較 UTC 與 UTC+8 的月份差異並計數

query: SELECT strftime('%Y', datetime(order_ts,'+8 hours')) y, COUNT(*) n FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) GROUP BY 1
validation_method: 依 UTC+8 年度分組統計有效訂單

query: SELECT status, COUNT(*) n FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
result: {"columns": ["status", "n"], "rows": [[0, 3003], [1, 3549], [2, 4870], [3, 39574], [9, 9004]]} | 解讀: 五個代碼均與文件一致，有效訂單 = status IN (1,2,3)，無文件未記載的狀態碼。

query: (document excerpt)
result: 待付款與已取消的訂單不算有效訂單。 | 解讀: 有效訂單 = 狀態 1/2/3。
validation_method: 文件原文引用；搭配 ev_status_payment_consistency 驗證

query: SELECT o.status, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) orders, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.payment_status='ok' THEN o.order_id END) paid_ok FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY o.status
validation_method: 訂單狀態與付款成功狀態對帳

query: SELECT payment_status, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) distinct_orders, SUM(amount_twd) amt FROM payments GROUP BY payment_status
result: {"columns": ["payment_status", "n", "distinct_orders", "amt"], "rows": [["failed", 13326, 11824, 125980715], ["ok", 47993, 47993, 447706825]]} | 解讀: ok 為 47993 列對應 47993 張訂單（無重複付款）；failed 13326 列僅涵蓋 11824 張訂單，部分訂單有多次失敗。若不過濾 ok 會高估實收金額。
validation_method: 依付款狀態比較列數與 distinct 訂單數

query: SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) failed_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id) failed_orders FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=p.order_id WHERE p.payment_status='failed' GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY o.status
result: {"columns": ["status", "failed_rows", "failed_orders"], "rows": [[0, 1486, 1486], [1, 534, 437], [2, 731, 580], [3, 6078, 4824], [9, 4497, 4497]]} | 解讀: 失敗紀錄會出現在待付款、已取消，也可能出現在後來付款成功的訂單，必須用 payment_status='ok' 而非存在性判斷。
validation_method: 失敗付款依訂單狀態分組

query: SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.unit_price_cents = p.list_price_twd*100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) at_list_x100, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.unit_price_cents = p.list_price_twd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) at_list_x1, MAX(oi.unit_price_cents) max_cents, MAX(p.list_price_twd) max_list FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id
result: {"columns": ["n", "at_list_x100", "at_list_x1", "max_cents", "max_list"], "rows": [[104966, 62574, 0, 1490000, 14900]]} | 解讀: 62574/104966 列恰等於標價×100，沒有任何列等於標價×1，其餘為折扣價。欄位名稱 cents 屬實，淨營收需 quantity*unit_price_cents/100 後才與 TWD 欄位（退款、實收）相加減。
validation_method: 換算單位對比目錄標價；列出未折扣列比例

query: SELECT o.coupon_code, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(AVG(oi.unit_price_cents*1.0/(p.list_price_twd*100)),4) avg_ratio, ROUND(MIN(oi.unit_price_cents*1.0/(p.list_price_twd*100)),4) min_ratio, ROUND(MAX(oi.unit_price_cents*1.0/(p.list_price_twd*100)),4) max_ratio FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id GROUP BY o.coupon_code
result: {"columns": ["coupon_code", "n", "avg_ratio", "min_ratio", "max_ratio"], "rows": [[null, 73540, 0.9443, 0.8, 1.0], ["SUMMER15", 15984, 0.9448, 0.8, 1.0], ["WELCOME10", 15442, 0.945, 0.8, 1.0]]} | 解讀: 比例吻合文件折扣（取整造成微小誤差），因此商品金額應直接使用 quantity*unit_price_cents，不得再套用折扣或改用 list_price_twd。
validation_method: 成交價/標價比例依優惠碼分組

query: (document excerpt)
result: 成交單價是客人實際付的價格（已含折扣與優惠碼），不是商品目錄上的標價。 | 解讀: 資料佐證此主張。
validation_method: 文件原文引用；與 ev_coupon_discount 對照

query: SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(p.amount_twd - t.item_twd) < 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) match_exact, SUM(CASE WHEN p.amount_twd > t.item_twd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) pay_gt, SUM(CASE WHEN p.amount_twd < t.item_twd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) pay_lt FROM payments p JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity*unit_price_cents/100.0) item_twd FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) t ON t.order_id=p.order_id WHERE p.payment_status='ok'
result: {"columns": ["n", "match_exact", "pay_gt", "pay_lt"], "rows": [[47993, 47993, 0, 0]]} | 解讀: 47993/47993 完全相符，payments.amount_twd 已是 TWD、無運費或手續費差異；實收金額與有效訂單的商品金額在訂單層級一致，但歸屬時間用付款成功時間。
validation_method: 付款成功金額與明細金額逐訂單對帳

query: SELECT items_per_order, COUNT(*) orders FROM (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) items_per_order FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) GROUP BY items_per_order ORDER BY items_per_order
result: {"columns": ["items_per_order", "orders"], "rows": [[1, 29911], [2, 18155], [3, 8991], [4, 2943]]} | 解讀: 多明細訂單佔相當比例，join order_items 後直接 COUNT(*) 會高估訂單數；所有訂單都至少有一筆明細（無孤兒訂單）。
validation_method: 每張訂單的明細數分布

query: SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN r.order_id=oi.order_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) order_consistent, SUM(CASE WHEN r.refund_amount_twd > oi.quantity*oi.unit_price_cents/100.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_refund, SUM(CASE WHEN r.refund_amount_twd = oi.quantity*oi.unit_price_cents/100.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) full_refund, SUM(r.refund_amount_twd) refund_twd FROM refunds r JOIN order_items oi ON oi.item_id=r.item_id
result: {"columns": ["n", "order_consistent", "over_refund", "full_refund", "refund_twd"], "rows": [[4039, 4039, 0, 2798, 18071770]]} | 解讀: 退款可準確回扣到原訂單與商品類別；退款金額單位為 TWD（與明細金額除以 100 同尺度，無超額退款）。
validation_method: 退款對明細金額對帳

query: SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) n, SUM(r.refund_amount_twd) amt FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=r.order_id GROUP BY o.status
result: {"columns": ["status", "n", "amt"], "rows": [[3, 4039, 18071770]]} | 解讀: 4039 筆退款全部對應 status=3 的有效訂單。
validation_method: 退款依原訂單狀態分組

result: 退款扣回它所屬的原訂單，不看退款發生在哪個月。 | 解讀: 淨營收與退款報表歸屬規則不同，兩者是不同指標，需分開建模。
validation_method: 文件原文引用；以 ev_refund_attribution_gap 量化兩種歸屬的差異

query: SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m',datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours'))<>strftime('%Y-%m',datetime(r.refund_ts,'+8 hours')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cross_month, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y',datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours'))<>strftime('%Y',datetime(r.refund_ts,'+8 hours')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cross_year FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=r.order_id
result: {"columns": ["n", "cross_month", "cross_year"], "rows": [[4039, 2072, 197]]} | 解讀: 文件的雙重歸屬規則在資料中確有實質影響；另外有 178 筆退款（金額 834879 TWD）發生在 2026 年，依退款時間不屬於 2025 年。
validation_method: 比較退款時間與訂單時間（均換算 UTC+8）的月份與年份

query: SELECT strftime('%Y', datetime(refund_ts,'+8 hours')) y, COUNT(*) n, SUM(refund_amount_twd) amt FROM refunds GROUP BY 1
validation_method: 退款依 UTC+8 年度分組

query: SELECT p.category, COUNT(*) n, SUM(r.refund_amount_twd) amt, SUM(CASE WHEN r.reason_code='R2' THEN r.refund_amount_twd ELSE 0 END) r2_amt FROM refunds r JOIN order_items oi ON oi.item_id=r.item_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY amt DESC
validation_method: 以 item_id 串接並依類別彙總

validation_method: distinct 值檢查

query: SELECT method, COUNT(*) n, SUM(amount_twd) amt FROM payments WHERE payment_status='ok' GROUP BY method ORDER BY amt DESC
result: {"columns": ["method", "n", "amt"], "rows": [["credit_card", 26469, 247206780], ["line_pay", 9402, 87353750], ["atm", 7330, 68895700], ["cod", 4792, 44250595]]} | 解讀: 實收金額依付款成功時間歸屬，且須過濾 failed；四種付款方式與文件一致。
validation_method: 過濾 ok 後依付款方式彙總

query: SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m',datetime(p.paid_ts,'+8 hours'))<>strftime('%Y-%m',datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) month_differs, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y',datetime(p.paid_ts,'+8 hours'))<>strftime('%Y',datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) year_differs FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=p.order_id WHERE p.payment_status='ok'
result: {"columns": ["n", "month_differs", "year_differs"], "rows": [[47993, 9, 2]]} | 解讀: 實收金額與營收的歸屬時間不同，是兩個獨立指標。

query: SELECT p.is_active, COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) products, SUM(oi.quantity) qty FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) GROUP BY p.is_active
result: {"columns": ["is_active", "products", "qty"], "rows": [[0, 35, 18790], [1, 165, 98410]]} | 解讀: is_active 反映『目前』狀態，不是銷售當時狀態；歷史銷量含下架商品。
validation_method: 有效訂單銷量依在售狀態分組

query: SELECT c.region_code, c.tier, COUNT(*) valid_orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y',datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours'))='2025' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC
validation_method: 客戶維度串接有效訂單並檢查代碼值

query: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) valid_orders, ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*)/SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (),2) pct FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y',datetime(order_ts,'+8 hours'))='2025' GROUP BY channel ORDER BY 2 DESC
result: {"columns": ["channel", "valid_orders", "pct"], "rows": [["web", 23899, 50.1], ["app", 16679, 34.97], ["store", 7121, 14.93]]} | 解讀: 通路代碼與文件一致；占比分母需先限定為台北時間 2025 的有效訂單。
validation_method: distinct 值與占比計算

query: SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN s.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) has_ship, SUM(CASE WHEN s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) delivered FROM orders o LEFT JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY o.status
validation_method: 訂單狀態與出貨紀錄對帳

query: SELECT COUNT(*) n, ROUND(AVG(julianday(delivered_ts)-julianday(shipped_ts)),2) avg_days, SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(delivered_ts)-julianday(shipped_ts) <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) on_time, SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(delivered_ts)<julianday(shipped_ts) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) negative FROM shipments WHERE delivered_ts IS NOT NULL
result: {"columns": ["n", "avg_days", "on_time", "negative"], "rows": [[39574, 2.9, 22733, 0]]} | 解讀: 配送天數為含小數的時間差，兩端時間同為 UTC 因此差值不受時區影響，但期間歸屬仍須依訂單成立時間（台北）。
validation_method: 計算配送天數並檢查負值
